title: The channel I kept
subtitle: My first YouTube channel died after one video. A year later I filmed myself learning to spin a basketball on one finger, and this time I didn’t quit.
videoTitle: How I Learned to Spin A Ball on Finger (Hindi)

title: First ₹600
subtitle: A senior paid me to edit his video. It was the first money I ever made, and I posted about it like I’d won the lottery.
tweetText:
Today, for the first time in my life, I earned money and it’s the best feeling. 🥳

I am 16 btw. 😄

title: No plan, just a camera
subtitle: I landed in an electronics degree I had zero interest in. So I kept making videos.
videoTitle: BITS Goa Hostel life | My experience | Nikhil Sheoran

title: Media Groww
subtitle: Editing for one senior turned into an agency with Jeet. Five creators on retainer, run from a hostel room.

title: FastCut
subtitle: Every client wanted the same edit, so Harsh and I automated it. 13,000 users in 38 countries, no investors. Then it ran out of momentum.

title: A hackathon, won
subtitle: Goa Police ran a hackathon. We won it, and I ended up demoing our project to the Director General of Police.
tweetText:
Woah so I showcased our hackathon project to DGP Goa today.

This hackathon thing is interesting.

title: SpotTheScam
subtitle: That project became a real tool, built with BITS Pilani and Goa Police. The Chief Minister launched it. The Times of India wrote about it.

title: Hired. Fired.
subtitle: Founding engineer at a startup, my first job. It lasted two months. I moved cities, ran a 10k and started over.
tweetText:
Time to reintroduce myself here:

> 19, ece@BITS goa
> fullstack web dev
> love tech & video editing
> built a startup around that, failed
> got a 50LPA remote job soon after
> didn’t work out, had to part ways
> moved to blr recently

Figuring out what’s next, hit me up if you…

title: Backdoor
subtitle: I had a job offer on the table. I turned it down to bet on myself again: an AI agent that lands you interviews at early-stage startups.
